name: fix-ci
title_zh: 红叉的 PR 检查，它顺着日志改到全绿为止
tagline_zh: PR 挂了一排红叉，点进去全是几千行日志，不知道哪行才是自己的锅。它先定位失败检查的归属 job，只改那一处。
tagline_en: A wall of red PR checks and thousands of log lines, with no clue which is yours. It finds the owning job, fixes.
desc_en: Diagnose failing pull request checks from their owning job logs and apply scoped fixes, verify them, and refresh remote CI until checks pass or an external blocker remains. Use when the user asks to repair failing PR CI.
why_zh: 先认领失败检查属于哪个 job，再动手；改完必跑验证，不靠猜。范围锁死在一处，不顺手重构你的代码。
why_en: It first claims which job owns the failing check, then edits; every fix is verified, never guessed. Scope stays locked to one.
limit_zh: 只处理 PR 上已存在的检查失败，不写新功能、不修本地跑挂的测试；外部阻塞（配额、密钥、上游服务）它只报告不动手。
limit_en: Only fixes checks already failing on a PR — no new features, no local-only test failures. External blockers (quota, secrets, upstream) are reported.
title_en: Turns red PR checks green by fixing from job logs
